steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Upper-lower interconnect
steps.body: Verify CN803 harness between upper washer sub PBA and lower main PBA. Check TX_OWM/RX_OWM and power lines.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify CN803 harness between upper washer sub PBA and lower main PBA. Check TX_OWM/RX_OWM and power lines.

steps.title: AC7 cleared?
steps.body: After reseating interconnect harness and power cycle, does AC7 clear?
steps.sourceExcerpt: After reseating interconnect harness and power cycle, does AC7 clear?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace main PBA on affected compartment.

steps.title: Replace main PBA
steps.oemOutcome: Replace main PBA when AC7 persists with good harness.
